summary.text: Ann Millner is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 5, which covers parts of Davis, Morgan and Weber counties, and has served since January 2015. She sits on the Senate Economic Development and Workforce Services Committee and the Senate Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: Millner's official legislative profile lists her profession as higher education.
She holds a B.S. from the University of Tennessee, an M.S. from Texas State, and an Ed.D. in educational administration from Brigham Young University.
